patches.description: Adds a 'Copy direct link' option to the pin menu to copy a link under the direct CDN media format instead of the standard Pinterest web link.
patches.name: Copy direct link

patches.description: Removes sponsored (promoted) pins from the home feed and from search/related/board feeds.
patches.name: Disable ads

patches.description: Adds a 'Download video' option to the pin menu for video pins, saving the clip to the Downloads folder.
patches.name: Download video

patches.description: Returns an empty Google Advertising ID and forces ‘limit ad tracking’, disabling ad tracking without causing the app to crash.
patches.name: Neutralize advertising ID

patches.description: It adds the ‘Set as wallpaper’ option to the pin menu, which downloads uses the image and sets it as the device’s wallpaper.
patches.name: Set pin as wallpaper
